let get_all_documents db : doc_meta list =
  DB.Documents.get_all db
  |> List.filter_map (fun ((meta : T.doc_meta), contents) ->
      match contents with
      | DB.Deleted -> None
      | DB.Active _ -> Some meta)

let get_document_meta db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t) : doc_meta option =
  let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
  match
    DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source
      source_doc.locator
  with
  | None -> None
  | Some (meta : T.doc_meta) -> (
      match DB.Documents.get_full_by_id db meta.doc_id with
      | Some (_, DB.Active _) -> Some meta
      | Some (_, DB.Deleted)
      | None ->
          None)

let document_ever_indexed db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t) : bool =
  let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
  DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source source_doc.locator
  <> None

let get_document db (doc_ref : doc_ref) : doc_meta * Util.Text_source.t =
  let full =
    match doc_ref with
    | By_locator src_doc ->
        let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
        Option.bind
          (DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source
             source_doc.locator) (fun (meta : T.doc_meta) ->
            DB.Documents.get_full_by_id db meta.doc_id)
    | By_id doc_id -> DB.Documents.get_full_by_id db doc_id
  in
  match full with
  | None ->
      let ref_str =
        match doc_ref with
        | By_locator src_doc -> App_types.Src_doc.show src_doc
        | By_id doc_id -> App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id
      in
      ksprintf failwith "Not indexed: %s" ref_str
  | Some (doc_meta, DB.Deleted) ->
      ksprintf failwith
        "Document %s was deleted (see 'skl text document put' to re-add it)"
        (App_types.Src_doc.show_source_doc doc_meta.source_doc)
  | Some (doc_meta, DB.Active contents) ->
      ( doc_meta,
        { Util.Text_source.name = doc_meta.source_doc.locator; contents } )

                                                                   
                                                                 
                                                              
let reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id ~(contents : DB.doc_contents) :
    doc_meta * anchor list =
  DB.Shingles.delete_doc db doc_id;
  DB.Documents_fuzzy.index db ~doc_id ~contents ~force:false;
  (match contents with
  | DB.Active c -> Anchor.index_shingles db ~doc_id c
  | DB.Deleted -> ());
  let doc_meta =
    match DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id with
    | Some m -> m
    | None -> failwith "internal error: just-registered document not found"
  in
  let changed =
    Anchor.relocate_stale_anchors db ~doc_id ~doc_revision:doc_meta.revision
  in
  (doc_meta, changed)

let add_file db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t)
    (text_source : Util.Text_source.t) : doc_meta * anchor list =
  let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
  Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
      ensure_source_declared db source_doc.source;
      let doc_id =
        DB.Documents.create_or_update db ~source:source_doc.source
          ~locator:source_doc.locator
          ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents)
      in
      DB.Containers.index db ~doc_id src_doc;
      reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id
        ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents))

let remove_document ?(strict = false) db (doc_ref : doc_ref) : anchor list =
  let doc_meta =
    match doc_ref with
    | By_locator src_doc ->
        let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
        DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source
          source_doc.locator
    | By_id doc_id -> DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id
  in
  match doc_meta with
  | None ->
      if strict then
        let ref_str =
          match doc_ref with
          | By_locator src_doc -> App_types.Src_doc.show src_doc
          | By_id doc_id -> App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id

item.text: I found four distinct failure modes: choosing a duplicate in another file, crossing source boundaries, suppressing review after a move, and losing matches for repeated text. I’m checking the stored revision and shingle behavior so the severity labels reflect the actual impact.

item.text:
I found four potential issues in anchor relocation:

- **P0 — An intact anchor can move to a duplicate in another file.** Candidate ranking breaks equal text matches by document ID, with no preference for the anchor’s current document. An unrelated edit can therefore silently change what document the anchor cites. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:355)

- **P0 — Relocation can cross source boundaries.** Hit collection searches the global shingle index without filtering by the anchor’s source. Deleting a snippet from one repository can attach its anchor to identical, unrelated text in another. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:206)

- **P0 — A moved anchor can later become stale without being flagged for review.** Relocation retains `acknowledged_revision`, but review compares that number with the destination document’s revision. Moving from a high revision document to a low revision one can suppress review after a failed later relocation. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:116) [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:512)

- **P1 — Repeated text can produce no relocation hits.** Shingle indexing discards every occurrence of a shingle that appears more than once in a document. A short anchor made of such text can become stale after an unrelated edit even while its text remains intact. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:159)
